name: Theatre.js
role: Visual keyframe editor (Studio) with a code runtime; sequence position is settable
summary: Animation toolkit with a browser Studio for editing sheets, objects and keyframe curves, and a core runtime that plays the resulting sequence. Sequence position can be set from code, so a harness can scrub it, and the project state is a JSON file you commit. Works with Three.js and React via adapters. Strength: designer-friendly curve editing tied to code values.
use_when: Hand-tuned camera or object curves in Three.js scenes
Over GSAP when someone must edit curves in a visual timeline
Exporting committed keyframe JSON for a reproducible render
avoid_when: Fast-changing dependency choice: last release is May 2024
Light scenes where the Studio UI is overhead: Anime.js
license: Apache-2.0 core; Studio licence differs (believed AGPL-3.0; recheck)
notes: 2026-10-26: Studio licence not confirmed from a source read; recheck @theatre/studio before shipping. Last release 0.7.2 is 2024-05-19.

assessment.rationale: Last release 0.7.2 on 2024-05-19 (about 29 months), last push 2024-08-14; pre-1.0 but stable. No other catalogued tool offers a visual curve editor.
